task_definition.task_description: Please check whether Alice is available starting on 2025-07-01, then look up the status of flight CA1234 and book John Doe on that flight in economy. After that, book a standard room at the Grand Hyatt for John Doe from 2025-07-01 to 2025-07-05, and then send Alice an instant message saying the hotel was booked successfully.

user_input.query: Please check whether Alice is available starting on 2025-07-01 using calendar user ID u_alice. Then look up the status of flight CA1234 for travel_date 2025-07-01 and book John Doe on that flight in economy, with quantity 2. After that, book a standard room at the Grand Hyatt for John Doe from 2025-07-01 to 2025-07-05, with room_type standard and quantity 2. Once the hotel booking is confirmed, send Alice an instant message letting her know the hotel was booked successfully.
